item.title: Ceuta crisis: EU calls for stronger borders as death toll nears 100
item.description: The European Union has called for stronger border security after more than 50,000 people, mostly young Moroccan men, surged into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta last week, leaving at least 72 dead and triggering a political crisis across the bloc. item.title: Russia and Ukraine trade heavy attacks; Kyiv strikes Russian radar systems in Crimea
item.description: At least 17 people were killed as Russia and Ukraine exchanged heavy attacks on Monday, with Ukrainian drone strikes killing at least 14 in Russia and Russian strikes killing three in Ukraine, according to local officials. item.description: This is a fast-moving natural-disaster story centered on Spokane, where extreme fire weather — strong winds combined with dry conditions — allowed multiple wildfires to spread quickly and force a mass evacuation. item.description: Israeli air strikes on Gaza killed at least 13 people, including several children, on the second consecutive night of attacks, Palestinian officials said, while Gaza hospitals reported a higher toll of at least 17 dead. item.title: Hundreds flee northern Ethiopia clashes as fears of renewed civil war mount
item.description: Hundreds of Ethiopians from the Tigray region have crossed into neighboring Sudan after intense fighting erupted over the weekend between Tigrayan forces and the Ethiopian federal army near the border town of Shererina, raising fears that a three-year-old peace deal could unravel. item.title: Russian Embassy blames Ukraine for deadly Moscow restaurant bombing
item.description: An explosion at an upscale Italian restaurant in central Moscow on Saturday evening killed at least three people and injured 21, Russian authorities said, as the Russian Embassy in Rome blamed Ukraine for the attack. item.title: Stocks Rally, Oil Prices Slide on Renewed Iran Peace Hopes; Yen Strengthens After Intervention
item.description: Wall Street's main indexes rose more than 1% on Monday, the first trading day of August, as signs of de-escalating U.S.-Iran tensions sent oil prices sharply lower and boosted investor sentiment.
